items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yes, but he was a tremendous entertainer. And we worked there for quite a while.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, but he was a tremendous entertainer. And we worked there for quite a while. All the stars from the loop, you know, the shows or clubs would come there. And I never will forget, Albert Topps was one of the most beautiful guys, I don't know how I could have forgotten him. He was so --
It doesn't have anything to do with his middle name, does it?
